instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a bright modern meeting room with a whiteboard in the background, the man in the white turtleneck (R2) on the left and the man in the khaki tunic (R1) on the right stand facing each other across a conference table. They are firmly shaking hands, their right hands clasped together. The man in the white turtleneck (R2) is seen in profile, while the man in the khaki tunic (R1) looks directly at him with a neutral expression. An open silver laptop sits on the table in the foreground under bright, diffused indoor lighting.
